entry_conditions: Supply the latest two causal 20 Hz observations in world coordinates, retaining qpos[0:9], qvel[9:18], TCP pose[18:25], red pose[25:32], blue pose[32:39] and both goals[41:47]. Positions and finger openings are metres, arm qpos are radians, quaternions are wxyz. This fixed model cannot receive the source proposal's eight-frame buffer, previous commands or explicit intended role. If no previous state exists, repeat the current state in both slots; this exact reset is trained with a missing-difference indicator. Entry need not be empty: fingers can be open during approach, closing or arrested around 0.0183 m each at the table, or closed on red while descending over red's tray goal with blue pending. Red near its goal plus blue still at the table identifies pending-blue context, while red/TCP proximity and aperture preserve the incoming payload identity. No hard start-pose or source-time test is imposed.
exit_conditions: Prefer a selected block in attached vertical lift or early goalward motion: a closed issued intent when known externally, measured holding-like finger width, a nearby TCP, elevation above the table and consistent TCP/object motion corroborate one another. They infer attachment, not measure contact. Demonstrated expanded exits are still moving with TCP/block center heights roughly 0.280-0.293 m and total finger width roughly 0.03652-0.03654 m; these are descriptive support, not hard thresholds, maximums or zero-qvel requirements. A geometric near-object condition alone is not a useful completed grasp. Earlier transfer inside the shared approach/closing/lift overlap is supported only when the successor retains the causal context and can finish the transition. This guidance does not add gripper release, clearance, speed or hold conditions to the task completion contract.
overlap_role: Train and act coherently over all expanded acquisition segments: initial red approach, aligned dwell, close, vertical lift and initial translation; incoming red lowering, release and empty retreat; then blue approach, dwell, close, lift and early translation. In demo10300 the shared regions are [75,182), [265,415) and [445,562); corresponding measured overlaps are retained in all other assigned demonstrations. The second segment is not reset to an empty-hand blue approach. At demo10300 290 the fingers are partly opening and red is already at tray height, while demo10301 293 only begins commanding release with fingers still arrested on red. The learned incoming mode covers both. No interpolation across the unassigned red transport gap is fabricated.
successor_readiness: Pass the latest causal observations, identities and goals, and describe whether the selected source is approaching, closing, lifting or translating; if blue is pending but red is still near the TCP over its goal, explicitly retain that incoming-red responsibility. Pass external command/history context if available to the inference agent or successor, but this model itself consumes only two states. A successor deliver_block must not assume attachment merely because control switched: it must be able to finish close and lift, or continue incoming release/retreat where appropriate. The policy has learned phase and readiness diagnostics through model.belief, but the fixed epsilon-only forward does not automatically export them or apply a switching threshold. Readiness probabilities are uncalibrated auxiliary predictions, not contact or success certificates.
failure_signatures: Watch for alternating +1/-1 gripper intents at nearly identical TCP poses, phase disagreement between release and grasp, predicted progress while the object remains stationary on the table, red being treated as released while it still follows the TCP, accidental loss of the previously placed red identity, or a reset causing unsupported late-transport actions. An arrested closed grasp must not be rejected because measured fingers are positive rather than the -0.01 m commanded target. qvel of the fingers can remain nonzero in arrested holds and is not itself proof of slipping. Long uncertainty, incompatible role inference or lack of expected object co-motion merits reassessment rather than an assumed successful handoff. Recovery behavior is not demonstrated.
continuation_guidance: Continue local acquisition while lowering/releasing incoming red, retreating empty toward blue, or resolving aligned dwell/closing without corroborated lift. Read finger aperture changes together with TCP/object relative displacement and goal-relative height to distinguish opening from closing and empty retreat from loaded lift. With only two samples the motion estimate spans nominally 0.05 s, so hold intent can remain ambiguous after reset. If entering during early lift such as demo10307 487, either continue this policy into useful elevation/early translation or transfer with the early-lift context to a successor that can finish lifting. Do not wait for zero velocity at the demonstrated exits. The framework executes eight actions per chunk; no model-side variable-rate 1-4-action scheduler is implemented. Invocation duration and policy selection remain external decisions, not a preset skill schedule.
limitations: The original heuristic's eight-observation/past-command/external-role proposal is adapted to two causal observations with learned uncertain age and reset augmentation. Belief is initialized each forward and filtered/forecast locally, not persisted across calls. Pending role is learned from demonstrated red-then-blue context; arbitrary blue-first commands, interrupted grasps, successful reversal or out-of-distribution recovery are unsupported. Soft phase and attachment labels use training-only masked future co-motion, finger aperture and commands; contact is not instrumented. The semi-Markov duration tail is censored at 7+ local steps, not a hard timeout. Learned confidence, finite transition preferences and geometric annotation scales are unvalidated design choices, not hard safety constraints. No IK, collision guarantee, images or geometric equivariance are claimed. Task success is only the supplied rotated-containment and z-tolerance conjunction for both objects.
